title.narrative: Reinforcing the collaboration for a better HIV and TB response in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Mozambique, HIV, Ministry of Health of Mozambique (MISAU)This program has the following goals: Reduce by 50% the number of the new HIV infections by 2017 against 2013 estimates. Reduce HIV Mortality by 30% by 2017 against the 2013 estimates. Reduce the incidence of TB in HIV infected persons (by provision of IPT and ART). Reduce the mortality from HIV in TB patients (by HTC and provision of early ART to all). Reduce the mortality from TB in HIV infected persons (by ICF and early TB treatment to all with TB). Reduce the rate of HIV transmission from mother to child to less than 5% by 2017. The objectives of this program are: Increase access for diagnosis, care and treatment of HIV for children. Increase awareness, distribute and promote consistent use of condoms and lubricants. Increase coverage to ART for HIV positive TB patients from 72% in 2013 to 90% in 2015 and 100% in 2017 (addressed in TB/HIV component). Increase TB screening in PLHIV to 90% in 2015. Increase the percentage of eligible (including WHO recommendations for-CD4<350) patients receiving antiretroviral treatment to 90% by 2017. Increase the uptake of IPT for eligible PLHIV to 90% by 2017. Outreach key populations with comprehensive HIV/TB package of services (female sex workers, migrant population, MSM, Youth and Adolescents). Reinforcing the collaboration for a better HIV and TB response in Mozambique
